---
title: "Kantsoner langs åker"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(mapview)
library(rmapshaper)
```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# AR5 polygons
ar5 <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_FKB/Original/FKB-AR5 FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_FKB-AR5_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fkb_ar5_omrade")

# Pollinator prediction raster
poll <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/polliland_akershus.tif")

# Gråareal
ga <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/LandCover/Norway_Grå_Arealer_versjon1/Original/Kart over grå arealer GeoPackage-format/32_25835_graastruktur_gpkg.gpkg", layer = "GraaArealFlate") %>% 
  st_transform(25832)

# jordkvalitet
jk <- st_read("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/jordkvalitet.gpkg", layer = "jordkvalitet") # 1 = svært god, 2 = god, 3 = mindre god

```

Reclassify AR5

```{r}

# classify fulldyrka jord and overflatedyrka jord as åker
# everything else as NA
ar5 <- ar5 %>%
  mutate(kantklasse = if_else(arealtype %in% c("21", "22", "23"), "Aker", NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kantklasse)) %>% 
  st_make_valid

# dissolve into a single geometry
aker <- ar5 %>% 
  summarize()
```

Buffer polygons and get difference

```{r}

aker_buff <- aker %>% 
  st_buffer(15)

aker_kant <- ms_erase(aker_buff, aker)
```

Remove grey area

```{r}

aker_kant_no_ga <- ms_erase(aker_kant, ga) %>% 
  st_make_valid()

```

Rasterize and get pollinator values

```{r}

kant_vect <- vect(aker_kant_no_ga)

kant_rast <- rasterize(kant_vect, poll, field = 1, background = 0,
                       touches = TRUE)

kant_poll <- ifel(kant_rast == 1, poll, NA)
```

Rasterize jordkvalitet

```{r}

# NB: this is only capturing field margins, so not likely representative of greater soil quality of the field- need to re-think the approach (there is no category 3 here)
jk_vect <- vect(jk)

jk_rast <- rasterize(jk_vect, poll, field = "jordkvalitet", touches = TRUE, fun = "max")

kant_jk <- ifel(kant_rast == 1, jk_rast, NA)

```

Where jordkvalitet = 2 and polinator high
